answer: A ember of per-task receipts records who did what, and the whisper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The nectar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
